name: Neuropixels 1.0 reference reconstruction
coordinate_system: X transverse; Y proximal from distal tip; Z toward recording face. Builder mm; GLB metres.

reconstruction_assumptions.site_numbering: geometric row order, NOT an electrical channel map
reconstruction_assumptions.tip_profile: symmetric straight-sided 175 um taper, 22.62 deg derived included angle; datasheet ~20 deg is approximate
reconstruction_assumptions.slot_geometry_status: SEM-inspired. Slot dimensions are NOT published metrology.
reconstruction_assumptions.porosity: Seeded procedural relief and normal texture, NOT measured pore dimensions, porosity, or electrochemistry.
reconstruction_assumptions.assembly: Published envelope dimensions; local outlines, component placements, layer thicknesses, trace routing and terminal outline reconstructed.
reconstruction_assumptions.gold: Gold-coloured appearance, not a verified metallization stack or conductor netlist.
reconstruction_assumptions.illustration_head: Separate drawing-matched concept head. Outline, pad layout and traces are NOT verified Neuropixels hardware.

limitations: Reference and visualisation only; not for fabrication or implantation.
No proprietary CMOS layout or internal layer stack reconstructed.
A reconstruction, not a manufacturer CAD model or a photogrammetric scan.
